form.content:
[text* your_name placeholder "Your name *"]
[tel* your_tel placeholder "Your phone *"]
[email* your_email placeholder "Your email *"]
[textarea your_message 10x3 placeholder "How can we help you ?"]
[submit class:btn-hidden-submit]

mail.subject: [_site_title] "[your_message]" [your_name] [your_tel]
mail.body:
From: [your_name] <[your_email]>
Telephone: [your_tel]

Message:
[your-message]

-- 
This e-mail was sent from a contact form on [_site_title] ([_site_url])

mail_2.subject: [_site_title] "[your-subject]"
mail_2.body:
Message Body:
[your-message]

-- 
This e-mail was sent from a contact form on [_site_title] ([_site_url])
